proof.text: Choose an index i0, possible because I is nonempty, and define sigmaP as the composite of its structure map with its presheaf coprojection. For any i, choose a common upper bound k of i and i0. Under.w for both transition maps and the cocone equations show that both composites equal the composite at k. Thus all structure maps induce sigmaP.

The hypothesis hp gives a colimit after evaluation at every open. Apply Mathlib evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits (CategoryTheory/Limits/FunctorCategory/Basic.lean) to obtain IsColimit p, then Sheaf.isColimitSheafifyCocone (CategoryTheory/Sites/Limits.lean) to obtain a colimit cocone c of sheaves on F composed with Under.forget O. Its coprojections are p.ι.app i composed with toSheafify by Sheaf.sheafifyCocone_ι_app_val.

Define sigma by composing sigmaP with toSheafify. The preceding equality of structure maps and the formula for the sheafified coprojections give (F.obj i).hom composed with c.ι.app i equal to sigma. Lift each coprojection with Under.homMk; naturality follows from c.w and Under.UnderMorphism.ext.

For an arbitrary algebra cocone s, descend its underlying sheaf cocone using the sheaf colimit c. The descent respects the structure map: factor sigma through the coprojection at i0, use the sheaf colimit factorization equation, then Under.w for s.ι.app i0. Factorization and uniqueness in Under O follow from those in sheaves using Under.UnderMorphism.ext. The required coprojection formula is Sheaf.sheafifyCocone_ι_app_val.
